title: AGAMOTTO: An AI-Enabled Framework for Time-Critical Tactical Course-of-Action Evaluation and Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.24568v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current command and control (C2) platforms lack integrated simulation capabilities that would allow commanders to dynamically explore courses of action (COAs) during live operations. This paper presents ongoing research and contributions to the development of AGAMOTTO (Advanced Guidance and Analytics for Military Operations, Tactical Threats, and Outcomes) as part of the overarching NGC2 program, which advances the Army's efforts to modernize C2 systems, such as the Tactical Assault Kit (TAK). The paper outlines the current design, preliminary findings, and the remaining research tasks, with an emphasis on how the completed work will support tactical decision-making in future time-constrained environments. While the full system is still under development, initial development and results demonstrate the feasibility of AGAMOTTO. Early experiments highlight both the potential benefits and practical constraints of deploying AI-enabled tools

translated_title: AGAMOTTO：一个面向时间紧迫条件下战术行动方案评估与生成的AI赋能框架
translated_abstract: 当前的指挥与控制（C2）平台缺乏集成的仿真能力，无法让指挥官在实时作战过程中动态探索行动方案（COA）。本文介绍了AGAMOTTO（军事行动、战术威胁与结果的高级指导与分析）开发过程中的进行中研究及贡献，该系统是整体NGC2项目的一部分，该项目致力于推进陆军C2系统的现代化，例如战术突击工具包（TAK）。本文概述了当前的设计、初步发现和剩余的研究任务，重点阐述了已完成的工作将如何在未来时间受限的环境中支持战术决策。虽然完整系统仍在开发中，但初步开发和结果已经证明了AGAMOTTO的可行性。早期实验既揭示了部署AI赋能工具的潜在益处，也指出了实际应用中的限制。
tldr: AGAMOTTO是一个AI赋能框架，通过集成仿真能力使指挥官能够在时间紧迫的实时作战中动态评估和生成战术行动方案，初步结果已验证该系统的可行性。
en_tdlr: AGAMOTTO is an AI-enabled framework that integrates simulation capabilities to enable commanders to dynamically evaluate and generate tactical courses of action during time-critical live operations, with initial results demonstrating its feasibility.
